result.summary: Found 1 visually broken issue: the bottom navigation is obscured by an overlapping black bar. Other partially visible items are intentional horizontal scrolling and bottom-of-viewport cutoff.

issues.description: A thick black horizontal bar overlays the bottom navigation, obscuring the middle search and saved/orders icons and making them unreadable and difficult to tap.
issues.suggestion: Remove the overlaying bar or reposition it as a proper home indicator within the safe area, and add bottom safe-area padding so all bottom navigation icons are fully visible and tappable.
